inquiries.query:
select
	sum(job_postings_fact.salary_year_avg) as salary_sum, 
    COUNT(*) as count_rows
from
	job_postings_fact;
    
select
	count(DISTINCT job_postings_fact.job_title_short) as job_type_total
from
	job_postings_fact;

select 
	job_postings_fact.job_title_short as jobs,
    count(job_postings_fact.job_title_short) as job_count, 
	avg(job_postings_fact.salary_year_avg) as salary_avg,
    min(job_postings_fact.salary_year_avg) as salary_avg_min, 
    max(job_postings_fact.salary_year_avg) as salary_avg_max
from 
	job_postings_fact
group by 
	job_postings_fact.job_title_short
having
	count(job_postings_fact.job_title_short) > 100
order by
	job_postings_fact.salary_year_avg;
inquiries.name: aggregation
